notes: Kai's AddAmmoTT wrench output, rewritten as host rules: a row aimed at a player or bot hands them rounds of one Tier+Tactical ammo type, or of every type with All. An amount of -1 fills the type to its most; Ignore Max lets the rounds go past it. Not ported yet: the ammo sets (Kai's packs and the weapon and grenade groups) as list choices.

handles.initAddAmmoTT: the host rules' AddAmmoTT output (behaviour.json brick_outputs): the list is All and the Tier+Tactical ammo types, then the amount and Ignore Max; a bot is a Player target here, so one output serves both
handles.call:initAddAmmoTT: the host rules' AddAmmoTT output, declared once when the rules load
handles.Player::addAmmoTT: the host rules' on_brick_output: set_reserve up to the type's most (its Max preference), or past it with Ignore Max
